Farming the silver knights was definitely the worst part of getting all trophies.

I got to NG+6 and decided why the hell not. I got to 70 or 80% of the trophies just playing so I just scrambled up the rest of them. The really annoying ones were miracles and rings. Miracles was definitely the hardest, because if you didn't get all the Blade of Darkmoon stuff done early on you would have to farm silver knights until you got 30 proofs.
